data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Provide Optimization Recommendations
features.description: Generate recommendations for pipeline optimization based on analysis results.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendations are based on identified performance trends

features.title: Analyze Pipeline Performance Metrics
features.description: Create algorithms to analyze pipeline execution metrics such as trends, completion times, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Trends in pipeline performance are identified
Stage completion times are calculated accurately
Success rates are determined for each pipeline stage

features.title: Professional Summaries and Visualizations
features.description: Include professional summaries and visualizations in the Jupyter notebook to enhance understanding.
acceptance_criteria: All visualizations are relevant to the analysis

features.title: Interactive Jupyter Notebook
features.description: Develop an interactive Jupyter notebook to present analysis results with visual insights.
acceptance_criteria: Notebook includes interactive elements for user engagement
Notebook layout is styled after the Salesforce AI demo

features.title: Load Pipeline Execution Data
features.description: Develop a module to load pipeline execution data into the analysis environment.
acceptance_criteria: Data is loaded from specified sources without errors
Data loading process is logged for auditing
Data is available for analysis within the Jupyter notebook
